relay.name: Connection service
relay.description: HTTPS service for pairing and P2P signaling; no video relay.

relayKey.name: Connection service key
relayKey.description: Private connection credential. Keep this secret.

adminKey.name: Administration key
adminKey.description: Private administration credential. Keep this secret.

cameras.name: Cameras
cameras.description: Camera sources. Prefer managing cameras in the web interface.

rtsp.name: RTSP address
rtsp.description: Private camera credential. Keep this secret.

onvifPassword.name: ONVIF password
onvifPassword.description: Private camera credential. Keep this secret.

onvifProfileToken.name: ONVIF profile token
onvifProfileToken.description: Private camera credential. Keep this secret.

directEnabled.name: Local HTTPS
directEnabled.description: Enable direct HTTPS access on the home network.

p2pEnabled.name: Direct P2P
p2pEnabled.description: Enable direct peer-to-peer access where the network allows it.

connectionMode.name: Connection mode
connectionMode.description: Direct: no relay for pairing, cameras or Home Assistant. Legacy: keeps the existing connection service.

externalOrigin.name: External bridge address (optional)
externalOrigin.description: Canonical HTTPS origin of this bridge, reachable from outside with the same TLS certificate. An HA URL alone is not a bridge address. No network configuration is changed.
